purpose: Defines the container conventions (location, structure, reading, error handling) of the optional project settings file .claude/.forge.yaml for tuning forge behavior, not the individual setting values.
summary: Overview of .claude/.forge.yaml and its relation to .doc_structure.yaml and .version-config.yaml
File conventions: optional file, git-managed under .claude/, top-level sections per feature area
Unknown sections are ignored for forward compatibility, within the constrained YAML subset
Schema ownership by the design document of each feature; snake_case names, defaults required
Reading centralized in forge_settings.py with load and section functions using a line-based stdlib parser
Scalar typing rules: booleans, integers, strings; list items always strings
Error handling: missing file is normal, unparsable or unreadable file raises SettingsError with line position
Section must be a mapping; value validation is the consumer responsibility
File is hand-written; an interactive setup SKILL is out of scope
Test design table for forge_settings.py under tests/forge/scripts
tasks: Adding a new configuration section to .claude/.forge.yaml
Reading forge project settings from a script
Writing tests for the settings reader
Deciding where a new forge configuration item belongs
